Export Script

Hi

This may seem like a trivial problem I have. I would like to write a basic script to export vertex, normal and UV coords for a single object in a scene.

I have a struct as such:

	
	


```
typedef struct {
    TextureCoord3D	texCoord;
    Vector3D		normal;
    Vertex3D		vertex;
} Cheetah3DVertexData;
```


So I want to export the data in the following format:

	
	


```
static const Cheetah3DVertexData vertexData[] = {
    {
        {1.00000, 1.00000 },
        {0.00000, 0.00000, 0.00000 },
        {0.00000, 0.00000, 0.00000 }
    },
    // etc...
};
```


It is basically a tweak to the embedded .h (header) exporter built into Cheetah3D - not sure if there is a script that demonstrates this.

The problem is I am not sure where to start with the scripting in Cheetah3D. I am going to read through the help files next.

Is this possible in Cheetah3D, I guess it is?
And as this likely to be the only script I write for Cheetah3D any pointers, relevant examples, or tips would be much appreciated.

Regards

John T

## #4 — Marraboy — 2010-06-29
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/5922/post-44300>

Hi

I actually decided to put a quick .Net/C# console app together to read in the .h file generated by the Cheetah export. I iterated through each line and converted the structs to what I required then output to a new file. I thought this would be quicker than learning how to script Cheetah.

I can either run it in Windows or OSX with Mono installed:

StructConvert.exe fileName
or
mono StructConvert.exe fileName

This suits my needs.

Ta

John T
